goal: Ensure depends package builds use dependencies from the depends prefix instead of host system libraries
Prevent compilation failures caused by version mismatches with host packages
reviewability: Waiting on author to address review feedback on build isolation before further review is useful
agreement: Nonblocking objection: preserving external paths undermines depends build isolation (hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: appending external paths instead of overwriting risks isolation (purpleKarrot)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it prevents depends package builds from inadvertently picking up host system libraries
Eliminates build and version mismatch errors when developers have host versions of dependencies installed
